message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling about costumes of the type that are flimsy, not suitable for ordinary wear. Such carnival-type costumes are classified in heading 9505 as festive articles. Heading 9505.90.6000 covers "Festive, carnival or other entertainment articles... other." The note to Chapter 95 excludes costumes only if they are well-made apparel, and Note 1(e) excludes fancy-dress apparel of textiles in Chapter 61 and 62 for ordinary wear. Costumes of loosely stitched construction that are not well made are classified in 9505.90.6000.

Subheading detail: 9505.10 covers Christmas articles, and 9505.90 covers other. Within 9505.90, the 10-digit codes are 9505.90.2000 (Confetti, paper spirals, ...) and 9505.90.4000 (Magic tricks and practical joke articles), 9505.90.6000 (Other). The statistical suffix for 9505.90.6000 is 9505.90.6000, which is the full 10-digit code.
